en: For this reason it must be said that nothing is known which is not in experience, or, however the same thing is also expressed, which is not present as felt truth, as an inwardly revealed eternal, as a believed holy, or whatever other expressions may be used.
For experience is precisely this, that the content — and it is spirit — is in itself, is substance, and hence is the object of consciousness.
But this substance, which spirit is, is its own becoming to that which it is in itself; and only as this becoming that reflects itself into itself is it, in itself, in truth the spirit.

It is in itself the movement that cognition is — the transformation of that in-itself into the for-itself, of substance into subject, of the object of consciousness into the object of self-consciousness, i.e. into an object that is just as much sublated, or into the concept.
It is the circle that returns into itself, which presupposes its beginning and reaches it only in the end.

– Insofar as spirit is thus necessarily this distinguishing-within-itself, its whole, intuited, steps over against its simple self-consciousness; and since that whole is what is distinguished, it is distinguished into its pure concept, into time, and into the content or into the in-itself; the substance, as subject, has in itself the first inner necessity of presenting itself at itself as what it is in itself, namely as spirit.
The completed objective presentation is first at the same time the reflection of it, or its becoming to self.
– Before, therefore, spirit has not completed itself in itself, not as world-spirit, it cannot as self-conscious spirit reach its consummation.
The content of religion therefore expresses earlier in time than science does what spirit is, but only science is its true knowledge of itself.
zh: 因此必须说：凡不在经验之中的东西就没有被认识；或者，无论同一件事以别的什么方式表达——凡不是作为被感受的真理、作为内在地被启示的永恒者、作为被信仰的圣者，或者无论人们还使用别的什么说法——而现存着的东西，就没有被认识。
因为经验恰恰就是这样一回事：内容——而内容就是精神——自在地是实体，因而也是意识的对象。
但这个精神所是的实体，就是它向它自在地所是的东西的生成；而只有作为这种在自身中反思自身的生成，它才自在地、在真理上就是精神。
它自在地就是那构成认识的运动——即把那个自在转化为自为、把实体转化为主体、把意识的对象转化为自我意识的对象，亦即转化为同样被扬弃了的对象或转化为概念的运动。
它是向自身中回归的圆圈，这个圆圈预设了自己的开端，并且只在终点才达到它。
——因此，只要精神必然地就是这种在自身之内的区分，它的整体就作为被直观到的东西站到它那简单的自我意识对面；而由于那个整体就是被区分出来的东西，它就被区分成它的纯粹概念、时间和内容或自在；实体作为主体，在自身那里首先具有这种内在的必然性：在自身那里把自己呈现为它自在地所是的东西，即呈现为精神。
完成了的对象性呈现，首先同时才就是它的反思，或者说它向自我的生成。
——因此，在精神还没有自在地、还没有作为世界精神完成自身之前，它就不能作为自我意识的精神达到它的完成。
因此，宗教的内容在时间上比科学更早地把精神是什么表述出来，但只有科学才是精神对自身的真的知识。

en: The movement of driving forth the form of its knowing of itself is the work that it accomplishes as actual history.

The religious community, insofar as it is at first the substance of absolute spirit, is the crude consciousness which has an all the more barbaric and harder determinate being the deeper its inner spirit is, and whose dull self [has] an all the harder work with its essence, the content of its consciousness that is foreign to it.

Only after it has given up the hope of sublating the being-foreign in an external, i.e. foreign manner, does it turn — because the sublated foreign manner is the return into self-consciousness — to itself, to its own world and present, discover it as its property and have thus taken the first step of descending from the intellectual world, or rather of inspiriting its abstract element with the actual self.
Through observation it finds, on the one hand, the determinate being as thought and comprehends it, and conversely, in its thinking, the determinate being.

In that it has thus at first itself abstractly expressed the immediate unity of thinking and being, of the abstract essence and the self, and expressed the first being-of-light more purely, namely as the unity of extension and being — for extension is the simplicity that is more equal to pure thinking than light is — and has thereby reawakened in thought the substance of the rising, the spirit at the same time recoils from this abstract unity, from this selfless substantiality, and asserts individuality against it.

But only after it has externalized this [individuality] in formation, thereby made it into determinate being and carried it through in all determinate being — has come to the thought of usefulness and in absolute freedom grasped determinate being as its will — does it thus turn outward the thought of its innermost depth and express the essence as Ich = Ich.

But this Ich = Ich is the movement that reflects itself into itself; for in that this equality, as absolute negativity, is the absolute difference, the self-equality of the I stands over against this pure difference, which, as the pure and at the same time objective difference for the self that knows itself, is to be expressed as time, so that, just as above the essence was expressed as the unity of thinking and extension, it would have to be grasped as the unity of thinking and time; but the difference left to itself, the restless and stayless time, collapses rather into itself; it is the objective rest of extension, but this is the pure equality with itself, the I.
– Or the I is not only the self, but it is the equality of the self with itself; this equality, however, is the perfect and immediate unity with itself, or this subject is just as much the substance.

The substance alone for itself would be the content-less intuiting, or the intuiting of a content which, as determinate, would have only accidentality and would be without necessity; the substance would count as the absolute only insofar as it were thought or intuited as the absolute unity, and all content would, according to its diversity, have to fall outside it into the reflection that does not belong to it, because it would not be grasped as subject, not as that which reflects over itself and into itself, or not as spirit.

If, nevertheless, a content were to be spoken of, then it would be partly only in order to throw it into the empty abyss of the absolute, partly, however, it would be externally picked up from sensuous perception; knowing would seem to have come to things, to the difference from itself, and to the difference of manifold things, without one's comprehending how and whence.
zh: 把关于自身的知识的形式驱迫出来的那种运动，就是精神作为现实的历史所完成的劳作。
宗教教团，只要它首先还是绝对精神的实体，就是粗糙的意识；这种意识的内在精神越深，它的定在就越野蛮、越严酷，它那迟钝的自我同它的本质——即对它来说异己的意识内容——所进行的劳作就越艰苦。
只有当它放弃了以外在的、即异己的方式去扬弃异己存在的希望之后，它才——因为被扬弃的异己方式就是向自我意识的回归——转向自身，转向它自己的世界和当下，把它们发现为它的财产，从而迈出了第一步：从理智世界降下来，或者毋宁说，用现实的自我去赋予理智世界的抽象元素以精神。
通过观察，它一方面把定在作为思想来发现并以概念把握它，反过来又在它的思维中发现定在。
由于它这样首先本身抽象地表述了思维与存在、抽象本质与自我的直接统一，并且更纯粹地表述了第一个光明本质，即把它表述为广延与存在的统一——因为广延是比光更接近纯粹思维的单纯性——并从而在思想中重新唤起了升起之光的实体，精神同时也就从这种抽象的统一、从这种无自我的实体性中惊退回来，并坚持个体性来反对它。
但只有当它在这种教养中外化了这种个体性，由此把它变成定在并在一切定在中贯彻了它——达到了有用性的思想，并在绝对自由中把定在把握为它的意志——它才从而把最内在深处的思想翻出来，并把本质表述为 Ich = Ich。

但这个 Ich = Ich 却是那种在自身中反思自身的运动；因为，由于这种等同作为绝对的否定性就是绝对的差别，我的自我等同就与这种纯粹的差别相对立，而这种纯粹的差别作为纯粹的、同时又是对那个认识自身的自我而言对象性的差别，必须被表述为时间；因此，正如先前本质被表述为思维与广延的统一，它也就应当被把握为思维与时间的统一；但是，听任自身摆布的差别，即那无静止、无停留的时间，毋宁说在自身中坍塌了；它是广延的对象性的静止，而这种静止就是与自身的纯粹等同，即我。
——或者，我不仅是自我，而且是自我与自身的等同；但这种等同就是与自身的完满的、直接的统一，或者说，这个主体同样也是实体。
独自自为的实体将是无内容的直观，或者是对一种内容的直观，这种内容作为特定的内容只有偶性、没有必然性；实体只有在被思维或被直观为绝对统一时，才被视为绝对者；而一切内容按其相异都必定落到实体之外、落入那种不属于实体的反思之中，因为实体没有被把握为主体，没有被把握为那种反思到自身之上并在自身中反思自身的东西，或者说没有被把握为精神。
假如毕竟还是要谈论一种内容，那么这种谈论一部分只是为了把它抛进绝对者的空洞深渊，一部分则只是把它从感性知觉中外在地捡拾起来；知识看来似乎达到了物、达到了它同自身的差别以及杂多事物的差别，却没有人理解它是如何达到的、从哪里达到的。

en: But spirit has shown itself to us to be neither merely the withdrawal of self-consciousness into its pure inwardness, nor the mere immersion of it in the substance and the non-being of its difference, but rather this movement of the self which externalizes itself and immerses itself in its substance and, equally as subject, has gone out of it into itself and makes it into object and content, in that it sublates this difference of objectivity and content.
That first reflection out of immediacy is the self-differentiating of the subject from its substance, or the concept that dirempts itself, the going-into-itself and becoming of the pure I.
In that this difference is the pure doing of the Ich = Ich, the concept is the necessity and the rising of the determinate being which has the substance as its essence and subsists for itself.

But the subsistence of the determinate being for itself is the concept posited in determinacy, and thereby equally its movement at itself, to go down into the simple substance, which is subject only as this negativity and movement.

– The I has neither to hold itself fast in the form of self-consciousness over against the form of substantiality and objectivity, as if it were afraid of its externalization — the power of spirit is rather to remain equal to itself in its externalization and, as the being that is in-and-for-itself, to posit the being-for-itself just as much only as a moment as the being-in-itself — nor is it a third that throws the differences back into the abyss of the absolute and expresses their equality therein; rather, knowing consists in this apparent inactivity, which only contemplates how the distinguished moves at itself and returns into its unity.
zh: 但精神已经向我们表明：它既不只是自我意识退回到它的纯粹内在性之中，也不只是自我意识单纯沉没在实体之中、沉没在它差别的非存在之中，而是自我的这样一种运动：自我外化自身，沉没进它的实体之中，同样也作为主体从实体中回到自身，并把实体变成对象和内容，同时扬弃了对象性与内容的这种差别。
那第一种从直接性中出来的反思，就是主体与其实体的区分自身，或者说自我分裂的概念，就是纯粹的我进入自身和生成。
由于这种差别就是 Ich = Ich 的纯粹行动，概念就是定在的必然性和升起，这个定在以实体为其本质，并且自为地持存着。
但定在的自为持存，就是在规定性中被设定的概念，因而同样也是概念在自身那里的运动，即下降到单纯的实体之中的运动；而实体只有作为这种否定性和运动才是主体。
——我既不必以自我意识的形式来固守自身、对抗实体性和对象性的形式，好像它害怕自己的外化似的——精神的力量毋宁在于：在外化中保持自身等同，并且作为自在自为的存在者，把自为存在与自在存在同样都只设定为环节——我也不必是什么第三者，把种种差别抛回绝对者的深渊并在其中表述它们的等同；毋宁说，知识就在于这种表面上的无所作为，它只是旁观那有差别的东西如何在自身那里运动、如何回到它的统一之中。

en: In knowing, spirit has thus concluded the movement of its forming, insofar as the latter is burdened with the unovercome difference of consciousness.
It has won the pure element of its determinate being, the concept.
The content, according to the freedom of its being, is the self that externalizes itself, or the immediate unity of self-knowing.
The pure movement of this externalization constitutes, when it is considered at the content, its necessity.

The different content, as determinate, is in the relation, not in itself, and is its restlessness to sublate itself, or the negativity; thus the necessity or diversity is, like the free being, just as much the self; and in this self-like form, in which the determinate being is immediately thought, the content is the concept.
In that spirit has thus won the concept, it unfolds the determinate being and movement in this ether of its life, and is science.

The moments of its movement present themselves in it no longer as determinate shapes of consciousness, but, in that the difference of the latter has gone back into the self, as determinate concepts and as the organic, in-itself-grounded movement of them.

If in the Phenomenology of Spirit each moment is the difference of knowing and truth and the movement in which it sublates itself, then science, by contrast, does not contain this difference and its sublating; rather, in that the moment has the form of the concept, it unites the objective form of truth and of the knowing self in immediate unity.

The moment does not step forth as this movement, of going over and back from consciousness or representation into self-consciousness and conversely; rather, its pure shape, freed from its appearance in consciousness — the pure concept and its further movement — hangs alone on its pure determinacy.
Conversely, to every abstract moment of science there corresponds a shape of the appearing spirit as such.
Just as the existing spirit is not richer than it, so in its content it is also not poorer.

To cognize the pure concepts of science in this form of shapes of consciousness constitutes the side of their reality, according to which their essence — the concept, which is posited in it in its simple mediation as thinking — splits apart the moments of this mediation and presents itself according to the inner opposition.
zh: 因此，精神在知识中完结了它形态化的运动，只要这种形态化还带有意识的那种未被克服的差别。
精神赢得了它定在的纯粹元素——概念。
按其存在的自由来说，内容就是外化自身的自我，或者说自我知识的直接统一。
这种外化的纯粹运动，如果从内容方面来考察它，就构成了内容的必然性。
那有差别的、作为特定的内容处在关系中而不是自在的，并且就是扬弃自身的那种不安，即否定性；因此，必然性或相异，如同自由的存在一样，同样也是自我；而在这种自我的形式中——定在在这种形式里直接就是思想——内容就是概念。
因此，由于精神赢得了概念，它就在它生命的这个以太中展开定在和运动，并且就是科学。
它运动的诸环节在其中不再表现为意识的特定形态，而是——由于意识的差别已经回到自我之中——表现为特定概念，表现为这些概念的那种有机的、在自身中奠定基础的运动。
如果说在《精神现象学》中，每一个环节都是知识与真理的差别，都是这种差别在其中扬弃自身的运动，那么与此相反，科学并不包含这种差别及其扬弃；而是，由于环节具有概念的形式，它就把真理的对象性形式和认识着的自我的对象性形式在直接统一中结合起来。
环节并不作为这种运动——即从意识或表象进入自我意识、又反过来来回穿梭——而出现；相反，它的纯粹的、摆脱了它在意识中的现象的形态，即纯粹概念及其继续推进，只系于它的纯粹规定性。
反过来，科学的每一个抽象环节，都对应着显现着的精神本身的一种形态。
正如定在着的精神并不比科学更富有，它在内容上也不比科学更贫乏。
在意识形态的这种形式中去认识科学的纯粹概念，就构成了它们的实在性的那一面；按照这一面，它们的本质——即在科学中、在其作为思维的简单中介里被设定的那个概念——把这种中介的诸环节拆分开来，并按照内在的对立把自己呈现出来。
